rules.quote: Where reference is made to this Article, passengers shall be offered free of charge: (a)meals and refreshments in a reasonable relation to the waiting time;

Where reference is made to this Article, passengers shall be offered free of charge: (b)hotel accommodation in cases where a stay of one or more nights becomes necessary, or where a stay additional to that intended by the passenger becomes necessary;
Where reference is made to this Article, passengers shall be offered free of charge: (c)transport between the airport and place of accommodation (hotel or other).
rules.action: offer transport between airport and accommodation

rules.quote: In addition, passengers shall be offered free of charge two telephone calls, telex or fax messages, or e-mails.

In applying this Article, the operating air carrier shall pay particular attention to the needs of persons with reduced mobility and any persons accompanying them, as well as to the needs of unaccompanied children.
rules.action: pay particular attention to specific needs
